IMPLEMENTED SCOPE
Completed batch View Effect / 查看效果 opens an actual derived result.
Lower-right Original / 原图 shows the linked immediate input while held and
restores Preset Effect on release, cancel, focus loss or Activity pause.
PhotoImageView preserves zoom/image position; same-dimension replacement
avoids transform-rounding drift. Existing keyboard/accessibility toggles
remain. HoldToCompare does not recycle caller-owned bitmaps.

Original lookup, verification and decode run off the UI/camera worker.
Request/current-photo identities discard stale results after navigation.
New outputs and verified cache hits persist the exact input association.
0.8.0 output-only records migrate lazily only after verified output plus
source-content/committed-preset/model content-key match. Lookup is bounded,
cancellable and never guesses by filename or project. Missing or changed
sources leave comparison unavailable without replacing the effect.
